projects.name: Azooma Escape
projects.description: Hide. Dodge flying slippers. Avoid that ONE uncle determined to feed you. Your mission: escape Uncle's celebration alive and unfed.

about.title: Project Overview
items: First Saudi stealth comedy game developed by ASH Studio.
Transforms a traditional family gathering (Azooma) into a stealth escape adventure.
Unique twist: Relatives replace guards – armed with food, questions, and endless hospitality.
Core gameplay: hide under tables, read NPC patterns, dodge crowds, and use teacups as last-resort tools.
Environments: vibrant courtyards, festival streets, and lively living rooms inspired by Saudi culture.
Tone: lighthearted, funny, and culturally authentic while delivering classic stealth tension.
Vision: showcase Saudi identity through comedy and chaos, creating a globally accessible gaming experience.

about.title: My Role
items: As part of the development team for Azooma Escape, I took on multiple responsibilities across design, programming, and UI:

Level Design – Focused on creating interactive puzzles and obstacles, designing enemy placements, and shaping open/closed paths to guide player progression. Ensured difficulty scaled gradually while keeping gameplay fresh with unique puzzle concepts.

Gameplay Programming – Implemented a wide range of systems, including crouch mechanics, achievement tracking, visual field detection, enemy animation alerts, and collectible item systems with persistent saving. Played a key role in building interactive mechanics that defined the player experience.

UI Integration – Rebuilt and programmed the entire UI, covering the HUD, main menu, and various sub-menus such as the collectibles screen. Ensured the interface was fully functional, cohesive, and matched the game’s playful tone.

Team Collaboration – Worked in a highly collaborative environment, quickly adapting to shifting roles between design, programming, and UI. Contributed original puzzle ideas and supported the team by taking on diverse tasks as the project evolved.

Problem Solving – Overcame challenges of joining a large, ongoing project unexpectedly by rapidly researching and understanding its systems. Adapted to changing responsibilities and maintained efficiency under shifting priorities.

about.title: Project Overview
items: A multiplayer party game with up to 100 players or less, depending on the map.
Includes diverse modes like Hide & Seek, Glass Bridge, Red Light Green Light, and temporary-tile survival challenges.
Designed for streamers on Twitch – supporters can join special rooms directly through Twitch integration, enhancing community interaction.

about.title: My Role
items: Took responsibility for removing old maps and creating new ones from scratch, working around 4 hours per day, and completed 3 different maps (such as Glass Bridge, Red Light Green Light, and temporary-tile survival) within 1–2 days each.
Designed a large-scale Hide & Seek map for 50+ players, which required 6 days due to its size and complexity.
Overcame the challenge of working with a pre-made Asset from the Asset Store by creating diverse visual and gameplay experiences while keeping performance optimized for Android devices.
Handled the lighting design for all maps, ensuring a balanced and appealing look. All maps were successfully integrated and made playable.
